subject: POC success criteria & POC plan - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed POC success criteria (next steps)

Thanks for the call today - great to meet the Atlas Payments team. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria and timeline.

Recap (30-min discovery):
- Primary use case: real-time transaction enrichment and automated dispute categorization in the payments pipeline.
- Expected QPS/throughput today: ~35 req/s peak, average ~10 req/s.
- Latency sensitivity: customer-facing enrichment needs p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms.
- Data sensitivity: PCI-adjacent, SOC 2 + specific audit logs required.

Proposed POC objectives (2-4 week POC):
1) Functional correctness: classification accuracy aligned to Atlas baseline (target: >= 90% top-label match on held-out set).
2) Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms during expected load; test at 1x and 2x current peak.
3) Throughput: sustain 50 req/s with <5% error rate.
4) Cost: target cost/token <= $0.002 (excl. embed/indexing) - will iterate with batching & quantization.
5) Reliability/observability: request-level tracing, per-route token breakdown, and KV-cache hit rate visibility.

Proposed evaluation plan / ownership:
- Redwood: provide sandbox endpoint, test harness, baseline evaluation scripts, and a short success-criteria spreadsheet (attached).
- Atlas: provide representative sample dataset (anonymized), procurement contact, and engineering point-of-contact for network whitelisting.

Timeline suggestion:
- Week 0 (this week): agree success criteria and sign minimal MOU / security addendum.
- Week 1: provisioning + ingest sample data; smoke tests.
- Week 2: run baseline evaluations (latency, throughput, quality).
- Week 3: tuning (batching, quantization) and retest; cost estimates.
- Week 4: recap, verdict, and potential rollout plan.

Next steps (please):
- Confirm POC length (2 vs 4 weeks) and target kickoff date.
- Provide Atlas engineering contact for firewall/egress rules.
- Confirm procurement contact for MOU.

Attaching: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx with suggested metrics and test cases.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

- Procurement asked for a rough cost estimate for the trial and any potential credits.

If we can get the SOC2 + network details and agree scope (2-week vs 4-week), we should be able to kick off next week.

- SOC 2 & security: attaching high-level SOC 2 summary and a link to our security pack; Marissa will follow up with the full evidence package via secured link.
- Trial cost estimate: we usually offer a sandbox trial credit for customers doing an evaluation; I'll confirm specifics with Finance.
- Network details: see Dev's note below for IP ranges and access requirements - we'll provide a more formal network allowlist once we confirm the POC topology.

Suggested plan: agree to a 2-week technical trial with an option to extend to 4 weeks if Atlas wants deeper cost optimization. If that sounds good, let's propose a kickoff on Mon, 9 Mar.

I've attached the POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx for clarity.

Jordan
